what_its_for: This medicine treats an enlarged prostate gland, also called benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH). It helps shrink the prostate over time and also relaxes the muscles around the prostate and bladder to make it easier to urinate. This combination can reduce your symptoms such as a weak urine stream, feeling like you cannot empty your bladder completely, and needing to urinate often or urgently.
how_to_take: Swallow one capsule whole with a full glass of water. Take it about 30 minutes after the same meal each day to help you remember and to reduce the chance of side effects. Do NOT crush, chew, or open the capsule. If the capsule is accidentally opened or broken, avoid touching the powder inside, especially near your eyes or mouth, and wash your hands right away.
dosing: The usual dose is one capsule (containing dutasteride 0.5 mg and tamsulosin 0.4 mg) taken by mouth once daily, about 30 minutes after a meal. Always take it at the same time each day. Do not take more than one capsule per day unless your doctor tells you to.
missed_dose: If you miss a dose and remember the same day, take it as soon as you remember, about 30 minutes after a meal. If it is already the next day, skip the missed dose and take your next dose at the regular time. Do NOT take two doses on the same day to make up for a missed one.
storage: Store the capsules at room temperature, between 59°F and 86°F (15°C to 30°C). Keep the bottle tightly closed and away from heat, moisture, and direct sunlight. Do not store in the bathroom. Keep this medicine out of reach of children and pets. Women who are pregnant or may become pregnant should not handle the capsules at all because the medicine can be absorbed through the skin and may harm an unborn baby.
what_to_avoid: Avoid donating blood while taking this medicine and for at least 6 months after you stop, because the blood could be given to a pregnant woman and harm her baby. Do not take this medicine with other alpha-blocker medicines such as doxazosin or terazosin without asking your doctor first. Avoid standing up too quickly from a sitting or lying position, especially in the first few weeks, as this medicine can lower your blood pressure and make you feel dizzy or faint. Use caution when driving or operating machinery until you know how this medicine affects you. Avoid drinking large amounts of alcohol while taking this medicine, as it may increase dizziness.
when_to_call_doctor: Call your doctor right away if you experience: severe dizziness or fainting; a painful erection that lasts more than 4 hours (priapism); breast lumps, pain, swelling, or nipple discharge; rash, hives, or swelling of the face, lips, tongue, or throat (signs of a serious allergic reaction); trouble swallowing; or unusual changes in your mood or mental health. Also tell your doctor if you are scheduled for cataract or glaucoma eye surgery, as this medicine can affect the surgery. Let your doctor know about ALL other medicines you take, including vitamins and supplements.
when_it_works: You may notice that it is easier to urinate within a few weeks of starting this medicine because tamsulosin relaxes the muscles quickly. However, dutasteride takes longer to shrink the prostate, so the full benefit of this combination may not be felt for 3 to 6 months or even longer. It is important to keep taking this medicine even if you feel better. Do not stop taking it without talking to your doctor first.
special_populations: This medicine is only for men. Women and children should not take it. Women who are pregnant or trying to become pregnant must not handle the capsules because dutasteride can be absorbed through the skin and cause birth defects in male babies. If a woman accidentally touches a broken capsule, she should wash the area with soap and water right away. Older men and men with liver problems should use this medicine with caution and should talk with their doctor about any dose adjustments. This medicine will lower your PSA blood test levels, which is used to screen for prostate cancer, so make sure any doctor who orders a PSA test knows you are taking this medicine.
